name: ragebait_critic_audit
description: Runs a ruthless, evidence-based AI audit against raw text, a local file, a URL, or a local project directory. Returns a structured JSON report containing verdict, findings, priority actions, blind spots, optional project audit metadata, and roast comments.

input_text.description: Raw text to audit. Exactly one of input_text, input_path, or input_url must be provided.

input_path.description: Path to a local file or local project directory. Exactly one of input_text, input_path, or input_url must be provided.

input_url.description: URL to fetch and audit. Exactly one of input_text, input_path, or input_url must be provided.

domain.description: Audit domain. Use auto unless the correct domain is already known.

language.description: Output language. Use auto to match the dominant input language. Examples: English, Turkish, Finnish.

roast_style.description: Optional roast style. Bully is opt-in and adds stand-up-style flaw-grounded roast comments.

output_format.description: Output format. Tool and agent integrations should use json.

output_path.description: Optional path where the generated report should be written.

model.description: Optional LiteLLM model override. Examples: openai/gpt-4o-mini, gemini/gemini-1.5-flash, ollama/llama3.1.

detect_only.description: If true, only process input and detect domain/language. Does not call the audit LLM.

preview_input.description: If true, only process and preview normalized input. Does not call the audit LLM.

use_llm_domain_detection.description: If true, uses LLM-assisted domain detection. By default, heuristic detection is used and does not call the LLM.

canonical_json_output.description: When output_format is json and a full audit is run, the tool returns the canonical Ragebait Critic AuditReport JSON object.

meta.description: Runtime metadata such as domain, language, model, source, input type, intensity, and roast style.

verdict.description: Top-level score, rage title, and summary.

findings.description: Concrete flaws with severity, evidence, impact, recommendations, and optional bully comments.

project_audit.description: Project-specific audit metadata. Present when domain is project.

priority_actions.description: Ranked actions ordered by real-world priority.

blind_spots.description: Risks or weaknesses the submitted work appears to ignore.

cli_examples.description: Audit a local project directory and write a JSON report.
cli_examples.command: python cli.py --input ./my-project --domain project --intensity nuclear --roast-style bully --format json --output ragebait_report.json
python cli.py --input ./src/api/auth.ts --domain code --intensity brutal --format json --output ragebait_code_report.json

cli_examples.description: Audit raw PR or marketing text.
cli_examples.command: python cli.py --text "Your landing page copy here" --domain pr --intensity brutal --format json --output ragebait_copy_report.json

cli_examples.description: Detect domain and language without calling the audit LLM.
Preview selected project files without calling the audit LLM.

agent_usage_notes: Use JSON output when another AI agent will consume the report.
Preview and detect-only modes do not call the audit LLM unless LLM domain detection is explicitly enabled.
Full audits require a configured LiteLLM provider and valid model credentials.
For local project audits, Ragebait Critic deliberately ignores .env files, node_modules, virtual environments, build folders, caches, and common binary assets.
The roast language is not the objective. The underlying findings, severity levels, evidence, and recommendations are the objective.
